classify.why_this_intent: The query requests total (sum) of Deposit and Withdrawal amounts, which maps to the numeric 'amount' field in the CashFlow class, grouped by the categorical 'segment' field of Investor.

generate.initial_sparql:
PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>
PREFIX wmmeta: <https://wealth.example.org/metadata/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema1: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?segment
       (SUM(IF(CONTAINS(?typeLower, "deposit"), xsd:decimal(?amount), 0)) AS ?depositTotal)
       (SUM(IF(CONTAINS(?typeLower, "withdrawal"), xsd:decimal(?amount), 0)) AS ?withdrawalTotal)
WHERE {
  ?cf a wm:CashFlow ;
      wm:amount ?amount ;
      wm:cashFlowOfInvestor ?inv ;
      wm:hasCashFlowType ?cft .
  ?inv wm:segment ?segment .
  BIND(LCASE(STRAFTER(STR(?cft), "#")) AS ?typeLower)
  FILTER(CONTAINS(?typeLower, "deposit") || CONTAINS(?typeLower, "withdrawal"))
}
GROUP BY ?segment

PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>
PREFIX wmmeta: <https://wealth.example.org/metadata/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema1: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?segment
       (SUM(IF(CONTAINS(LCASE(?cftLabel), "deposit"), xsd:decimal(?amount), 0)) AS ?depositTotal)
       (SUM(IF(CONTAINS(LCASE(?cftLabel), "withdrawal"), xsd:decimal(?amount), 0)) AS ?withdrawalTotal)
WHERE {
  ?inv a wm:Investor ;
       wm:segment ?segment ;
       wm:hasCashFlow ?cf .
  ?cf a wm:CashFlow ;
      wm:hasCashFlowType ?cft ;
      wm:allowedValue ?amount .
  ?cft rdfs:label ?cftLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?cftLabel), "deposit") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?cftLabel), "withdrawal"))
}
GROUP BY ?segment
